independence: Inventory and predefined cells are based only on unchanged publisher PDFs, independent pypdf text scans and Poppler page renders. No PaperVault/Docling parser output was consulted.
counting_policy: One logical object per numbered Figure/Table caption. Shared-caption subpanels count once. Numbered equations, algorithms and body-text references do not add figures/tables. Continuations of one numbered table count once. Whole main PDF including appendices is in scope; externally linked supplements are not.

review_levels.deep_review: All figure/table source pages visually inspected in detail, with ten predefined semantic cells; output quality comparison is separate and not yet implied.
review_levels.inventory_only: Full-PDF text scan plus source-page confirmation of numbered caption candidates; no complete cell-fidelity or output-crop audit is claimed.
